154	# ── AOI position helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────
155	
156	def aoi_position_ids(seq_len: int, batch_size: int, device, training: bool = True) -> torch.Tensor:
157	    """LongSpec Anchor-Offset Indices.
158	
159	    sink ~ U[0, AOI_MAX_SINK]
160	    offset ~ U[0, AOI_CAP - seq_len]
161	    pos = arange(seq_len), pos[sink:] += offset
162	    """
163	    if not training or seq_len >= AOI_CAP:
164	        return torch.arange(seq_len, device=device).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1)
165	
166	    offset_max = max(0, AOI_CAP - seq_len)
167	    rows = []
168	    for _ in range(batch_size):
169	        sink = random.randint(0, AOI_MAX_SINK)
170	        offset = random.randint(0, offset_max)
171	        pos = torch.arange(seq_len, device=device)
172	        pos[sink:] += offset
173	        rows.append(pos)
174	    return torch.stack(rows, dim=0)
175	
176	
177	# ── Cross-doc attention mask ───────────────────────────────────────────
178	
179	def build_attention_mask_with_docs(seq_len: int, document_ids: torch.Tensor,
180	                                    device) -> torch.Tensor:
181	    """Combine causal mask with cross-doc mask.
182	
183	    document_ids: (B, S) per-token doc id
184	    Returns: (B, 1, S, S) additive mask (-inf where blocked, 0 otherwise)
185	    """
186	    B, S = document_ids.shape
187	    # Causal: lower triangular
188	    causal = torch.tril(torch.ones(S, S, device=device))  # (S, S)
189	    # Cross-doc: keep only when doc_id_q == doc_id_k
190	    doc_eq = (document_ids.unsqueeze(2) == document_ids.unsqueeze(1)).float()  # (B, S, S)
191	    combined = causal.unsqueeze(0) * doc_eq  # (B, S, S)
192	    additive = torch.where(combined > 0, 0.0, float("-inf"))
193	    return additive.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, S, S)
194	
195	
196	# ── LK^λ loss ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
197	
198	def lk_lambda_loss_topk(target_logits_values: torch.Tensor,
199	                        target_logits_indices: torch.Tensor,
200	                        target_logsumexp: torch.Tensor | None,
201	                        draft_logits: torch.Tensor,
202	                        t2d: torch.Tensor,
203	                        draft_idx_map: torch.Tensor,
204	                        kl_scale: float = LK_KL_SCALE,
205	                        kl_decay: float = LK_KL_DECAY,
206	                        mask: torch.Tensor | None = None) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
207	    """LK^lambda loss on the collected target top-K support.
208	
209	    Equivalent to dense-scatter over topK∩draft-vocab but never materializes
210	    a (B, S, full_vocab) tensor. ``draft_logits`` may be bf16 or fp32; reduce-
211	    style ops upcast internally and we only realize fp32 on K=128 slices.
212	    """
213	    indices = target_logits_indices.long().clamp(0, VOCAB_SIZE - 1)
214	    in_draft = t2d[indices]
215	    mapped_idx = draft_idx_map[indices]
216	    target_values = target_logits_values.float()
217	
218	    # Fuse 5 where(...)s + logsumexp into one masked log_softmax + boolean
219	    # multiplies. F.log_softmax computes (logits - logsumexp(logits)) in one
220	    # fused kernel; the masked-out positions sit at -inf in support_logits
221	    # so they end up at -inf in log_p_support, and we zero-mask before any
222	    # arithmetic that would propagate -inf into NaN.
223	    neg_inf = torch.finfo(target_values.dtype).min
224	    in_draft_f = in_draft.to(target_values.dtype)   # (B, S, K) float mask
225	    support_logits = torch.where(in_draft, target_values, neg_inf)
226	    log_p_support = F.log_softmax(support_logits, dim=-1)
227	    # Zero-mask before downstream products so 0 * -inf doesn't appear.
228	    log_p_support = log_p_support * in_draft_f
229	    p_support = log_p_support.exp() * in_draft_f
230	
231	    # Draft normalizer: logsumexp upcasts to fp32 internally even for bf16
232	    # input; we then keep it in fp32 for KL math. The full (B,S,V) tensor is
233	    # never realized as fp32.
234	    draft_log_z = torch.logsumexp(draft_logits, dim=-1, keepdim=True).float()
235	    support_log_q = draft_logits.gather(2, mapped_idx).float() - draft_log_z
236	    kl = (p_support * (log_p_support - support_log_q) * in_draft_f).sum(dim=-1)
237	
238	    if target_logsumexp is None:
239	        full_log_z = torch.logsumexp(target_values, dim=-1)
240	    else:
241	        full_log_z = target_logsumexp.float()
242	    p_on_draft_support = torch.exp(target_values - full_log_z.unsqueeze(-1)) * in_draft_f
243	    q_support = support_log_q.exp() * in_draft_f
244	    alpha = torch.minimum(p_on_draft_support, q_support).sum(dim=-1)
245	
246	    if mask is not None:
247	        m = mask.float()
248	        n_valid = m.sum().clamp(min=1.0)
249	        kl_loss = (kl * m).sum() / n_valid
250	        acceptance_rate = (alpha * m).sum() / n_valid
251	    else:
252	        kl_loss = kl.mean()
253	        acceptance_rate = alpha.mean()
254	    kl_weight = kl_scale * torch.exp(-kl_decay * acceptance_rate.detach())
255	    loss = kl_weight * kl_loss + (1.0 - kl_weight) * (1.0 - acceptance_rate)
256	    return loss, acceptance_rate.detach()
257	
258	
259	# ── V4 Model: extends v3 model with cross-doc + assistant mask aware forward ──
260	
261	class Eagle3ModelV4(v3train.Eagle3Model):
262	    """Extends v3 Eagle3Model: AOI + LK^λ + response-only mask + cross-doc attn.
263	
264	    forward() accepts additional inputs: assistant_mask, document_ids.
265	    """
266	
267	    def __init__(self, embed_weight, lm_head_weight):
268	        super().__init__(embed_weight, lm_head_weight)
269	        # Override RoPE cache to support large positions (226K). Cast to the
270	        # training dtype so RoPE multiplies stay in bf16 (avoids implicit
271	        # fp32 promotion against bf16 q/k).
272	        cos, sin = v3train._build_rope_cache(HEAD_DIM, max_seq=ROPE_MAX_SEQ, theta=ROPE_THETA)
273	        self.midlayer.self_attn.rope_cos = cos.to(DEVICE).to(DTYPE)
274	        self.midlayer.self_attn.rope_sin = sin.to(DEVICE).to(DTYPE)
275	        self.ttt_steps = TTT_STEPS
276	        self.loss_decay = LOSS_DECAY
277	
278	    def load_v4_vocab_cache(self, cache_path: Path):
279	        """Override v3's build_vocab_mapping with force-included d2t."""
280	        d = torch.load(cache_path, weights_only=True)
281	        d2t = d["d2t"]
282	        selected_ids = d["selected_ids"]
283	        # t2d: target_id → True if in draft subset
284	        t2d = torch.zeros(VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.bool)
285	        t2d[selected_ids] = True
286	        # draft_idx_map: target_id → its slot in [0, 32000) or 0 if not in subset
287	        draft_idx_map = torch.zeros(VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.long)
288	        for slot, tid in enumerate(selected_ids.tolist()):
289	            draft_idx_map[tid] = slot
290	        # Move to whichever device the model already lives on (model.to(DEVICE) ran before this)
291	        device = next(self.parameters()).device
292	        self.register_buffer("t2d", t2d.to(device))
293	        self.register_buffer("draft_idx_map", draft_idx_map.to(device))
294	        self.register_buffer("d2t", d2t.to(device))
295	        if self._full_lm_head_weight is not None:
296	            with torch.no_grad():
297	                self.lm_head.weight.copy_(self._full_lm_head_weight[d2t.cpu()].to(self.lm_head.weight.device))
298	            self._full_lm_head_weight = None
299	            print(f"[v4 vocab] initialized lm_head from target ({len(selected_ids)} rows)")
300	        print(f"[v4 vocab] loaded {cache_path}: {len(selected_ids)} draft tokens, "
301	              f"forced={d['forced_ids']}, coverage={d['coverage_pct']:.4%}, device={device}")
302	
303	    def forward(self, token_ids, aux_hidden, target_logits_values, target_logits_indices,
304	                target_logsumexp=None, assistant_mask=None, document_ids=None,
305	                is_packed: bool = False, return_stats: bool = False):
306	        """V4 forward with AOI + LK^λ + response-only + cross-doc.
307	
308	        is_packed: caller-supplied flag. True iff document_ids encodes multi-
309	            segment packing (set by ``make_packed_batch``). Avoids a GPU sync
310	            on the hot path. False (default) → single-doc per row, SDPA flash.
311	        """
312	        B, S_orig = token_ids.shape
313	        device = token_ids.device
314	        T = self.ttt_steps
315	        S = S_orig - 1
316	
317	        # Cache FP4-quantized weights so the 3-step TTT loop reuses them
318	        # instead of re-quantizing every Linear on every step.
319	        v3train.fp4_quant_freeze(self)
320	
321	        # Pre-extend with (T-1) zero pad on the right so per-step shifts are
322	        # plain slices of the pre-padded tensor instead of three cat()s per
323	        # tensor per step. Step k uses [:, 1+k : 1+k+S] of every payload.
324	        T_pad = T - 1
325	
326	        def _pad_right(t, pad_count, fill=0):
327	            if pad_count == 0:
328	                return t
329	            shape = list(t.shape)
330	            shape[1] = pad_count
331	            return torch.cat([t, torch.full(shape, fill, dtype=t.dtype, device=device)], dim=1)
332	
333	        ext_token_ids = _pad_right(token_ids, T_pad)
334	        ext_target_values = _pad_right(target_logits_values, T_pad, fill=0)
335	        ext_target_indices = _pad_right(target_logits_indices, T_pad, fill=0)
336	        ext_target_lse = _pad_right(target_logsumexp, T_pad) if target_logsumexp is not None else None
337	        ext_assist = _pad_right(assistant_mask, T_pad, fill=False) if assistant_mask is not None else None
338	
339	        if document_ids is not None:
340	            document_ids = document_ids[:, 1:]
341	
342	        aux_shifted = aux_hidden[:, :-1, :]
343	        hidden = self.fc(aux_shifted)
344	
345	        # Embed once for every position any TTT step will need. Step k
346	        # consumes input_emb_all[:, 1+k : 1+k+S] (length S, no copy).
347	        input_emb_all = self.embed_tokens(ext_token_ids) * self.scale_emb
348	        input_emb_all = input_emb_all.to(hidden.dtype)
349	
350	        # Pre-build cross-doc + causal mask for each TTT step.
351	        # cache_k[0]'s columns correspond to step 0's packed positions (which
352	        # encode original document_ids). Query rows in step k correspond to
353	        # token packed[p+1+k], whose doc is document_ids shifted by k, with
354	        # shifted-out positions filled with a VOID doc id that never matches
355	        # any real seg — so those rows can attend to nothing on cache_k[0].
356	        # In single-doc path, step 0 uses SDPA flash (mask=None), step k>0
357	        # manual path needs a plain causal mask.
358	        if S > 0:
359	            causal_bool = torch.ones(S, S, device=device, dtype=torch.bool).tril()
360	        else:
361	            causal_bool = None
362	        if is_packed and document_ids is not None and S > 0:
363	            VOID_DOC = torch.iinfo(document_ids.dtype).max
364	            k_doc = document_ids                    # cache_k[0]'s doc layout (fixed)
365	            q_doc = document_ids                    # mutated each step
366	            per_step_masks = []
367	            for step in range(self.ttt_steps):
368	                doc_eq = q_doc.unsqueeze(2).eq(k_doc.unsqueeze(1))   # (B, S, S) bool
369	                per_step_masks.append((doc_eq & causal_bool).unsqueeze(1))
370	                if step < self.ttt_steps - 1:
371	                    pad = torch.full((B, 1), VOID_DOC,
372	                                     dtype=q_doc.dtype, device=device)
373	                    q_doc = torch.cat([q_doc[:, 1:], pad], dim=1)
374	            base_position_ids = aoi_position_ids_packed(
375	                S, B, document_ids, device, training=self.training,
376	                aoi_cap=AOI_CAP, aoi_max_sink=AOI_MAX_SINK,
377	            )
378	        else:
379	            # Single-doc: step 0 → None (flash via is_causal); step k>0 → causal_bool.
380	            single_causal = (causal_bool.view(1, 1, S, S)
381	                             if causal_bool is not None else None)
382	            per_step_masks = [None] + [single_causal] * (self.ttt_steps - 1)
383	            base_position_ids = aoi_position_ids(S, B, device, training=self.training)
384	
385	        step_losses = []
386	        step_accs = []
387	        step_corrects = []
388	        step_valids = []
389	        cache_k_list = None
390	        cache_v_list = None
391	
392	        for step in range(T):
393	            position_ids = base_position_ids + step * S
394	            offset = 1 + step
395	
396	            input_emb = input_emb_all[:, offset:offset + S]
397	            target_values = ext_target_values[:, offset:offset + S, :]
398	            target_indices = ext_target_indices[:, offset:offset + S, :]
399	            target_logsumexp = ext_target_lse[:, offset:offset + S] if ext_target_lse is not None else None
400	            assistant_mask = ext_assist[:, offset:offset + S] if ext_assist is not None else None
401	
402	            if sdpa_kernel is not None and SDPA_BACKEND_PRIORITY is not None:
403	                with sdpa_kernel(SDPA_BACKEND_PRIORITY, set_priority=True):
404	                    hidden_out, cache_k_list, cache_v_list = self.midlayer(
405	                        input_emb, hidden, cache_k_list, cache_v_list,
406	                        causal_mask=None, position_ids=position_ids,
407	                        packed_attn_mask=per_step_masks[step],
408	                    )
409	            else:
410	                hidden_out, cache_k_list, cache_v_list = self.midlayer(
411	                    input_emb, hidden, cache_k_list, cache_v_list,
412	                    causal_mask=None, position_ids=position_ids,
413	                    packed_attn_mask=per_step_masks[step],
414	                )
415	            hidden = hidden_out
416	
417	            with torch.no_grad():
418	                target_argmax_full = target_indices[:, :, 0].long().clamp(0, VOCAB_SIZE - 1)
419	                target_in_draft = self.t2d[target_argmax_full]
420	                if assistant_mask is not None:
421	                    mask = target_in_draft & assistant_mask.bool()
422	                else:
423	                    mask = target_in_draft
424	
425	            normed = self.norm(hidden_out)
426	            # Keep logits in bf16 — reductions inside the loss upcast as needed.
427	            logits = self.lm_head(normed)
428	
429	            loss, _ = lk_lambda_loss_topk(
430	                target_values, target_indices, target_logsumexp,
431	                logits, self.t2d, self.draft_idx_map, mask=mask,
432	            )
433	            step_losses.append(loss)
434	
435	            with torch.no_grad():
436	                pred_idx = logits.argmax(-1)
437	                target_draft_idx = self.draft_idx_map[target_argmax_full]
438	                correct = (pred_idx == target_draft_idx).float() * mask.float()
439	                n_correct = correct.sum().item()
440	                n_valid = mask.float().sum().item()
441	                step_corrects.append(n_correct)
442	                step_valids.append(n_valid)
443	                step_accs.append(n_correct / (n_valid + 1e-6))
444	
445	        total_loss = sum(self.loss_decay ** i * l for i, l in enumerate(step_losses))
446	        # Release the FP4 cache; weights will be re-quantized on next forward.
447	        v3train.fp4_quant_unfreeze(self)
448	        if return_stats:
449	            return total_loss, step_losses, step_accs, {
450	                "correct": step_corrects, "valid": step_valids,
451	            }
452	        return total_loss, step_losses, step_accs
453

455	# ── V4 dataloader (bf16 or NVFP4-aux .pt) ──────────────────────────────
456	
457	def load_sample_v4(pt_path: Path) -> dict:
458	    """Load one v4 .pt on CPU and decode NVFP4 aux storage if present."""
459	    sample = torch.load(pt_path, weights_only=True, map_location="cpu")
460	    if nvfp4_codec.is_nvfp4_sample(sample):
461	        sample = nvfp4_codec.decompress_sample(sample)
462	    return sample
463	
464	
465	def _slice_sample(sample: dict, max_len: int, tail: bool) -> dict:
466	    tok_key = "token_ids" if "token_ids" in sample else "input_ids"
467	    n = int(sample[tok_key].shape[0])
468	    if n <= max_len:
469	        return sample
470	    start = n - max_len if tail else 0
471	    out = dict(sample)
472	    for key in (
473	        tok_key,
474	        "aux_hidden",
475	        "top_logit_values",
476	        "top_logit_indices",
477	        "target_logsumexp",
478	        "assistant_mask",
479	        "document_ids",
480	    ):
481	        if key in sample and torch.is_tensor(sample[key]) and sample[key].shape[0] == n:
482	            out[key] = sample[key][start:start + max_len]
483	    return out
484	
485	
486	def make_batch_v4(samples: list[dict], max_len: int, device: str = DEVICE,
487	                  tail: bool = False) -> dict:
488	    """Slice/pad v4 samples and transfer the resulting batch to GPU."""
489	    samples = [_slice_sample(s, max_len, tail=tail) for s in samples]
490	    tok_key = "token_ids" if "token_ids" in samples[0] else "input_ids"
491	    seq_len = min(max(s[tok_key].shape[0] for s in samples), max_len)
492	
493	    def stack_key(key, pad_value):
494	        ts = []
495	        for s in samples:
496	            t = s[key]
497	            if t.shape[0] > seq_len:
498	                t = t[-seq_len:] if tail else t[:seq_len]
499	            elif t.shape[0] < seq_len:
500	                pad_shape = list(t.shape)
501	                pad_shape[0] = seq_len - t.shape[0]
502	                pad = torch.full(pad_shape, pad_value, dtype=t.dtype)
503	                t = torch.cat([t, pad], dim=0)
504	            ts.append(t)
505	        return torch.stack(ts).to(device, non_blocking=True)
506	
507	    batch = {
508	        "token_ids": stack_key(tok_key, 0).long(),
509	        "aux_hidden": stack_key("aux_hidden", 0.0).to(DTYPE),
510	        "target_logits_values": stack_key("top_logit_values", 0.0).to(torch.float32),
511	        "target_logits_indices": stack_key("top_logit_indices", 0).long(),
512	        "target_logsumexp": stack_key("target_logsumexp", 0.0).to(torch.float32),
513	        "assistant_mask": stack_key("assistant_mask", 0).bool(),
514	        "document_ids": stack_key("document_ids", 0).long(),
515	        "is_packed": False,
516	    }
517	    return batch
518

520	class PrettyLogger:
521	    def __init__(self):
522	        self.console = Console() if RICH_AVAILABLE else None
523	
524	    def print(self, msg: str):
525	        if self.console:
526	            self.console.print(msg)
527	        else:
528	            print(msg)
529	
530	    def table(self, title: str, rows: list[tuple[str, str]]):
531	        if not self.console:
532	            print(f"\n{title}")
533	            for k, v in rows:
534	                print(f"  {k}: {v}")
535	            return
536	        table = Table(title=title, show_header=False, title_style="bold cyan")
537	        table.add_column("Key", style="cyan", no_wrap=True)
538	        table.add_column("Value", style="white")
539	        for k, v in rows:
540	            table.add_row(k, v)
541	        self.console.print(table)
542	
543	    def metrics_table(self, title: str, step: int, ind: list[float] | None,
544	                      ood: list[float] | None, best: float):
545	        if not self.console:
546	            print(f"[eval step={step}] IND={ind} OOD={ood} best_ood0={best:.5f}")
547	            return
548	        table = Table(title=title, title_style="bold magenta")
549	        table.add_column("Split", style="cyan")
550	        for i in range(TTT_STEPS):
551	            table.add_column(f"step{i}", justify="right")
552	        table.add_column("select", justify="right", style="green")
553	        if ind is not None:
554	            table.add_row("IND", *[f"{x:.5f}" for x in ind], "")
555	        if ood is not None:
556	            table.add_row("OOD", *[f"{x:.5f}" for x in ood], f"best={best:.5f}")
557	        self.console.print(table)

560	def evaluate_v4(model: Eagle3ModelV4, val_dir: Path, max_files: int,
561	                seq_len_max: int, label: str, tail: bool,
562	                logger: PrettyLogger) -> list[float] | None:
563	    files = sorted(val_dir.glob("*.pt"))
564	    if not files:
565	        logger.print(f"[yellow][eval] {label}: missing {val_dir}[/yellow]" if RICH_AVAILABLE else f"[eval] {label}: missing {val_dir}")
566	        return None
567	    if max_files > 0:
568	        files = files[:max_files]
569	
570	    model.eval()
571	    correct = [0.0] * TTT_STEPS
572	    valid = [0.0] * TTT_STEPS
573	    iterator = files
574	    if RICH_AVAILABLE and logger.console:
575	        iterator = logger.console.status(f"[bold]Evaluating {label} ({len(files)} files)...")
576	
577	    with torch.no_grad():
578	        if RICH_AVAILABLE and logger.console:
579	            with iterator:
580	                for f in files:
581	                    sample = load_sample_v4(f)
582	                    batch = make_batch_v4([sample], seq_len_max, tail=tail)
583	                    _, _, _, stats = model(**batch, return_stats=True)
584	                    for i in range(TTT_STEPS):
585	                        correct[i] += stats["correct"][i]
586	                        valid[i] += stats["valid"][i]
587	                    del sample, batch, stats
588	                    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
589	        else:
590	            for f in tqdm(files, desc=f"eval {label}", unit="file"):
591	                sample = load_sample_v4(f)
592	                batch = make_batch_v4([sample], seq_len_max, tail=tail)
593	                _, _, _, stats = model(**batch, return_stats=True)
594	                for i in range(TTT_STEPS):
595	                    correct[i] += stats["correct"][i]
596	                    valid[i] += stats["valid"][i]
597	                del sample, batch, stats
598	                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
599	
600	    model.train()
601	    gc.collect()
602	    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
603	    return [correct[i] / max(valid[i], 1.0) for i in range(TTT_STEPS)]
604

606	def save_best_weights(model: Eagle3ModelV4, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer | None,
607	                      output_dir: Path, metadata: dict) -> Path:
608	    """Atomic save of model weights + optimizer state to best.pt.
609	
610	    optimizer is optional — pass None to skip (e.g. final dump only). When
611	    present, ``optimizer.state_dict()`` is included so a resume picks up
612	    the AdamW momentum/v vectors instead of restarting from zero.
613	    """
614	    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
615	    ckpt = {
616	        "model_state_dict": {
617	            k: v.detach().cpu()
618	            for k, v in model.named_parameters()
619	            if not k.startswith("embed_tokens")
620	        },
621	        **metadata,
622	    }
623	    if optimizer is not None:
624	        ckpt["optimizer_state_dict"] = optimizer.state_dict()
625	    out_path = output_dir / "best.pt"
626	    tmp_path = output_dir / "best.pt.tmp"
627	    torch.save(ckpt, tmp_path)
628	    tmp_path.replace(out_path)
629	    return out_path

637	# ── Async batch prefetcher ─────────────────────────────────────────────
638	
639	class _BatchPrefetcher:
640	    """Background-thread batch builder so disk IO overlaps GPU compute.
641	
642	    The worker calls ``build_one_batch_fn()`` to produce one optimizer-microbatch
643	    (already on the target device) and pushes it to a bounded queue. The
644	    training main thread pulls via ``next_batch()``; if the worker had
645	    completed the batch ahead of time the call is near-instant.
646	
647	    Single-process, single CUDA context — torch.Tensor producer/consumer
648	    across two threads is safe so long as both share the default stream
649	    (we never touch streams here).
650	
651	    On any per-batch exception, the worker pushes a sentinel so the main
652	    loop can ``continue`` to the next microbatch instead of dying. The
653	    underlying error is logged via ``on_error``.
654	    """
655	    _SKIP = object()
656	
657	    def __init__(self, build_one_batch_fn, queue_size: int = 2,
658	                 on_error=None):
659	        self._fn = build_one_batch_fn
660	        self._on_error = on_error
661	        self._q: "_queue.Queue" = _queue.Queue(maxsize=queue_size)
662	        self._stop = threading.Event()
663	        self._th = threading.Thread(target=self._worker, name="batch-prefetcher", daemon=True)
664	        self._th.start()
665	
666	    def _worker(self):
667	        while not self._stop.is_set():
668	            try:
669	                batch = self._fn()
670	            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
671	                if self._on_error is not None:
672	                    try:
673	                        self._on_error(exc)
674	                    except Exception:
675	                        pass
676	                batch = self._SKIP
677	            # bounded put; honour stop in case main is shutting down
678	            while not self._stop.is_set():
679	                try:
680	                    self._q.put(batch, timeout=1.0)
681	                    break
682	                except _queue.Full:
683	                    continue
684	
685	    def next_batch(self):
686	        """Blocking pull. Returns the batch dict or None on per-batch failure."""
687	        item = self._q.get()
688	        if item is self._SKIP:
689	            return None
690	        return item
691	
692	    def close(self):
693	        self._stop.set()
694	        # drain so worker can exit
695	        try:
696	            while True:
697	                self._q.get_nowait()
698	        except _queue.Empty:
699	            pass
700	        self._th.join(timeout=2.0)
701	
702	
703	def main():
704	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
705	    ap.add_argument("--smoke", action="store_true", help="short smoke train")
706	    ap.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=5000)
707	    ap.add_argument("--eval_every", type=int, default=250)
708	    ap.add_argument("--data_dir", default=str(DATA_DIR))
709	    ap.add_argument("--val_ind_dir", default=str(VAL_IND_DIR))
710	    ap.add_argument("--val_ood_dir", default=str(VAL_OOD_DIR))
711	    ap.add_argument("--vocab_cache", default=str(VOCAB_CACHE_V4))
712	    ap.add_argument("--output_dir", default=str(OUTPUT_DIR))
713	    ap.add_argument("--seq_len", type=int, default=SEQ_LEN_MAX)
714	    ap.add_argument("--eval_max_ind", type=int, default=200)
715	    ap.add_argument("--eval_max_ood", type=int, default=64)
716	    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=SEED)
717	    ap.add_argument("--resume", default="", help="resume model weights from best.pt")
718	    ap.add_argument("--empty_cache_every", type=int, default=25,
719	                    help="release PyTorch CUDA cache every N optimizer steps; 0 disables")
720	    args = ap.parse_args()
721	    if args.smoke:
722	        args.steps = min(args.steps, 4)
723	        args.eval_every = min(args.eval_every, 2)
724	        args.eval_max_ind = min(args.eval_max_ind, 4)
725	        args.eval_max_ood = min(args.eval_max_ood, 4)
726	
727	    logger = PrettyLogger()
728	    torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
729	    random.seed(args.seed)
730	
731	    data_dir = Path(args.data_dir)
732	    val_ind_dir = Path(args.val_ind_dir)
733	    val_ood_dir = Path(args.val_ood_dir)
734	    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
735	    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
736	    vocab_cache = Path(args.vocab_cache)
737	    if not vocab_cache.exists():
738	        raise FileNotFoundError(
739	            f"{vocab_cache} missing. Build it with "
740	            "python3 eagle/legacy/v4/pipeline/build_vocab_cache.py --in <prompts.jsonl>"
741	        )
742	
743	    # Build model
744	    logger.print("[bold cyan][sala_draft][/bold cyan] loading embed + lm_head" if RICH_AVAILABLE else "[sala_draft] loading embed + lm_head")
745	    embed_w, lm_head_w = v3train.load_embed_and_lm_head()
746	    logger.print(f"[sala_draft] embed shape: {tuple(embed_w.shape)}, lm_head shape: {tuple(lm_head_w.shape)}")
747	
748	    model = Eagle3ModelV4(embed_w, lm_head_w).to(DEVICE).to(DTYPE)
749	    model.load_v4_vocab_cache(vocab_cache)
750	    v3train.init_mlp_from_target(model)
751	
752	    resume_step = 0
753	    resume_best_ood0 = -1.0
754	    resume_best_step = None
755	    resume_optimizer_state_dict = None
756	    if args.resume:
757	        resume_path = Path(args.resume)
758	        if not resume_path.exists():
759	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"resume checkpoint not found: {resume_path}")
760	        logger.print(f"[bold yellow][sala_draft][/bold yellow] resuming weights from {resume_path}" if RICH_AVAILABLE else f"[sala_draft] resuming weights from {resume_path}")
761	        ckpt = torch.load(resume_path, weights_only=True, map_location="cpu")
762	        missing, unexpected = model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model_state_dict"], strict=False)
763	        resume_step = int(ckpt.get("global_step", 0) or 0)
764	        resume_best_ood0 = float(ckpt.get("best_ood0", -1.0) or -1.0)
765	        resume_best_step = resume_step if resume_best_ood0 >= 0 else None
766	        # Optimizer state lives in best.pt now (since 2026-05-07). Older
767	        # checkpoints lack it — we fall back to fresh AdamW silently.
768	        resume_optimizer_state_dict = ckpt.get("optimizer_state_dict", None)
769	        out_best = output_dir / "best.pt"
770	        if not out_best.exists():
771	            shutil.copy2(resume_path, out_best)
772	        logger.table("Resume State", [
773	            ("checkpoint", str(resume_path)),
774	            ("resume_step", str(resume_step)),
775	            ("best_ood0", f"{resume_best_ood0:.5f}" if resume_best_ood0 >= 0 else "n/a"),
776	            ("missing keys", str(len(missing))),
777	            ("unexpected keys", str(len(unexpected))),
778	            ("optimizer", "loaded from ckpt" if resume_optimizer_state_dict is not None else "fresh (legacy ckpt)"),
779	        ])
780	        del ckpt
781	        gc.collect()
782	        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
783	
784	    # Load dataset
785	    files = sorted(data_dir.glob("*.pt"))
786	    if not files:
787	        logger.print(f"[red][sala_draft] no train data in {data_dir}[/red]" if RICH_AVAILABLE else f"[sala_draft] no train data in {data_dir}")
788	        return
789	    random.shuffle(files)
790	
791	    pack_sampler = None
792	    if PACK:
793	        # Build / reuse a length index, then construct an FFD sampler.
794	        len_cache = data_dir.parent / f"{data_dir.name}.lengths.json"
795	        lengths = index_lengths(data_dir, len_cache)
796	        rng = random.Random(args.seed)
797	        pack_sampler = PackedFileSampler(
798	            files=files, lengths=lengths,
799	            max_len=args.seq_len, min_seg_len=PACK_MIN_SEG,
800	            ttt_pad=TTT_STEPS, rng=rng,
801	        )
802	        logger.table("Pack sampler", [
803	            ("files indexed", str(pack_sampler.stats()["n_files"])),
804	            ("min/mean/max len", f"{pack_sampler.stats()['min_len']} / "
805	                                  f"{pack_sampler.stats()['mean_len']:.1f} / "
806	                                  f"{pack_sampler.stats()['max_len']}"),
807	            ("max_len budget", str(args.seq_len)),
808	            ("min_seg_len", str(PACK_MIN_SEG)),
809	            ("ttt_pad", str(TTT_STEPS)),
810	        ])
811	
812	    # Build optimizer with weight-decay split: norm scales and biases
813	    # never decay (standard LLM convention). embed_tokens is frozen so it
814	    # does not appear in either group.
815	    decay_params, no_decay_params = [], []
816	    decay_names, no_decay_names = [], []
817	    for name, p in model.named_parameters():
818	        if not p.requires_grad:
819	            continue
820	        if name.endswith(".bias") or name.endswith("norm.weight"):
821	            no_decay_params.append(p)
822	            no_decay_names.append(name)
823	        else:
824	            decay_params.append(p)
825	            decay_names.append(name)
826	    # fused=True uses the multi-tensor CUDA AdamW kernel; ~50-100 ms/step
827	    # saved on a 500M-param model vs the foreach Python path.
828	    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(
829	        [
830	            {"params": decay_params, "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY},
831	            {"params": no_decay_params, "weight_decay": 0.0},
832	        ],
833	        lr=LR, betas=BETAS, fused=True,
834	    )
835	    logger.print(
836	        f"[opt] AdamW: {len(decay_params)} decayed, {len(no_decay_params)} no-decay "
837	        f"(no-decay sample: {no_decay_names[:3]})"
838	    )
839	
840	    # If resume ckpt carried optimizer state, load it now so momentum/v survive.
841	    if resume_optimizer_state_dict is not None:
842	        try:
843	            opt.load_state_dict(resume_optimizer_state_dict)
844	            logger.print("[resume] optimizer state loaded (m/v restored)")
845	        except Exception as e:
846	            logger.print(f"[resume] optimizer state incompatible, skipping: {e}")
847	        resume_optimizer_state_dict = None  # release
848	
849	    warmup_steps = max(WARMUP_MIN, int(round(args.steps * WARMUP_RATIO)))
850	    logger.print(
851	        f"[lr] schedule: warmup {warmup_steps} step → cosine decay to "
852	        f"{LR_MIN_FACTOR:.0%} of LR over {args.steps - warmup_steps} step "
853	        f"(LR={LR:g}, end_LR={LR*LR_MIN_FACTOR:g})"
854	    )
855	
856	    def lr_for_step(step: int) -> float:
857	        """Linear warmup → cosine decay.
858	
859	        warmup: LR * (step / warmup_steps)
860	        post-warmup: LR * (LR_MIN_FACTOR + (1 - LR_MIN_FACTOR) * 0.5 *
861	                           (1 + cos(pi * progress)))
862	        progress = (step - warmup_steps) / (total_steps - warmup_steps)
863	        """
864	        if step < warmup_steps:
865	            return LR * step / max(1, warmup_steps)
866	        total = max(args.steps, warmup_steps + 1)
867	        progress = (step - warmup_steps) / max(1, total - warmup_steps)
868	        progress = min(1.0, max(0.0, progress))
869	        cos_factor = 0.5 * (1.0 + math.cos(math.pi * progress))
870	        return LR * (LR_MIN_FACTOR + (1.0 - LR_MIN_FACTOR) * cos_factor)
871	
872	    def set_optimizer_lr(lr_value: float):
873	        for group in opt.param_groups:
874	            group["lr"] = lr_value
875	
876	    effective_bs = BATCH_SIZE * GRAD_ACCUM
877	    natural_steps_8ep = math.ceil(len(files) / effective_bs) * 8
878	    logger.table("SALA Draft Training Plan", [
879	        ("train", f"{len(files)} files @ {data_dir}"),
880	        ("IND eval", f"{len(list(val_ind_dir.glob('*.pt')))} files @ {val_ind_dir}"),
881	        ("OOD eval", f"{len(list(val_ood_dir.glob('*.pt')))} files @ {val_ood_dir}"),
882	        ("steps", f"{args.steps} optimizer steps"),
883	        ("eval", f"every {args.eval_every} steps + step 0"),
884	        ("batch", f"bs={BATCH_SIZE}, grad_accum={GRAD_ACCUM}, effective={effective_bs}"),
885	        ("seq_len", str(args.seq_len)),
886	        ("8 epoch equivalent", f"{natural_steps_8ep} steps after 200 IND holdout"),
887	        ("save policy", "only overwrite best.pt when OOD step0 improves"),
888	    ])
889	
890	    model.train()
891	
892	    log_path = output_dir / "train_log.jsonl"
893	    if log_path.exists() and args.smoke:
894	        log_path.unlink()
895	
896	    file_pos = 0
897	    recent_losses = []
898	    recent_acc0 = []
899	    best_ood0 = resume_best_ood0
900	    best_step = resume_best_step

902	    def next_files(n: int) -> list[Path]:

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""
3	Convert EAGLE-3 training checkpoint to sglang-compatible format.
4	
5	When FP4_QAT=True (default), packs BF16 master weights into NVFP4 format
6	(weight_packed uint8 + weight_scale fp8 + weight_scale_2 f32) so the
7	sglang model can be loaded with quantization="modelopt_fp4" and Marlin
8	W4A16 dispatch.  No post-training optimization — weights trained with
9	FP4QATLinear are already on the FP4 grid.
10	
11	Produces a directory with:
12	  - config.json (LlamaConfig-compatible, quantization_config set for NVFP4)
13	  - model.safetensors (weights: NVFP4 for linear layers, BF16 for norms)
14	
15	Usage:
16	    python3 eagle/convert_to_sglang.py
17	"""

19	import json

42	AUX_DIM = HIDDEN_SIZE * 3  # 12288

53	# ── NVFP4 packing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
54	
55	# FP4 E2M1 values and rounding boundaries
56	_FP4_POS = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0])
57	_FP4_BOUNDS = torch.tensor([0.25, 0.75, 1.25, 1.75, 2.5, 3.5, 5.0])
58	
59	
60	def _fp4_round(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
61	    """Round to nearest FP4 E2M1 value (float output)."""
62	    pos = _FP4_POS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
63	    bounds = _FP4_BOUNDS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
64	    sign = x.sign()
65	    idx = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=6.0), bounds)
66	    return sign * pos[idx]
67	
68	
69	def _float_to_fp4_nibble(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
70	    """Map FP4 float values to 4-bit nibble indices (0-15).
71	
72	    Encoding (FP4 E2M1):
73	      0→0, 1→0.5, 2→1.0, 3→1.5, 4→2.0, 5→3.0, 6→4.0, 7→6.0
74	      8→-0, 9→-0.5, 10→-1.0, ..., 15→-6.0
75	    """
76	    bounds = _FP4_BOUNDS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
77	    sign = (x < 0).to(torch.uint8)
78	    idx = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=6.0), bounds).to(torch.uint8)
79	    return idx | (sign << 3)  # 0-7 positive, 8-15 negative
80	
81	
82	def pack_nvfp4(weight: torch.Tensor, group_size: int = FP4_GROUP_SIZE):
83	    """Pack a BF16 weight matrix into NVFP4 format.
84	
85	    Args:
86	        weight: (N, K) BF16 tensor (N = out_features, K = in_features)
87	        group_size: elements per FP8 scale group (must be 16 for NVFP4)
88	
89	    Returns:
90	        weight_packed:  (N, K//2) uint8    — two FP4 nibbles per byte
91	        weight_scale:   (N, K//group_size) float8_e4m3fn  — per-group FP8 scale
92	        weight_scale_2: scalar float32     — global scale for the FP8 scales
93	    """
94	    assert weight.ndim == 2, f"Expected 2D weight, got {weight.ndim}D"
95	    N, K = weight.shape
96	    assert K % group_size == 0, f"K={K} must be divisible by group_size={group_size}"
97	
98	    w = weight.float().cpu()
99	    # Reshape into groups: (N, K/G, G)
100	    w_g = w.reshape(N, K // group_size, group_size)
101	
102	    # Per-group scale = max(|w|) / 6.0  (FP4 max magnitude = 6.0)
103	    per_group_scale = w_g.abs().amax(dim=-1).clamp(min=1e-8) / 6.0  # (N, K/G)
104	
105	    # Global FP32 scale: normalise per-group scales to fit in fp8_e4m3fn range
106	    fp8_max = 448.0  # float8_e4m3fn max
107	    global_scale_val = float(per_group_scale.amax().clamp(min=1e-8).item() / fp8_max)
108	
109	    # Encode per-group scales as FP8 (round-trip to get exact values used)
110	    scales_f32 = (per_group_scale / global_scale_val).clamp(-fp8_max, fp8_max)
111	    weight_scale_fp8 = scales_f32.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)  # (N, K/G)
112	
113	    # Actual per-group scale after FP8 rounding
114	    actual_scale = weight_scale_fp8.float() * global_scale_val  # (N, K/G)
115	    actual_scale_exp = actual_scale.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, group_size)  # (N, K/G, G)
116	
117	    # Scale weights, round to FP4 grid
118	    w_scaled = (w_g / actual_scale_exp).clamp(-6.0, 6.0)
119	    w_fp4 = _fp4_round(w_scaled.reshape(N, K))  # (N, K) float, values ∈ FP4 grid
120	
121	    # Encode each value as a 4-bit nibble index
122	    nibbles = _float_to_fp4_nibble(w_fp4)  # (N, K) uint8, range 0-15
123	
124	    # Pack: even column → low nibble, odd column → high nibble
125	    even = nibbles[:, 0::2]        # (N, K//2)
126	    odd  = nibbles[:, 1::2]        # (N, K//2)
127	    weight_packed = (even | (odd << 4)).to(torch.uint8)  # (N, K//2)
128	
129	    weight_scale_2 = torch.tensor(global_scale_val, dtype=torch.float32)
130	
131	    return weight_packed, weight_scale_fp8, weight_scale_2
132

134	def add_nvfp4_tensors(
135	    tensors: dict,
136	    sglang_key: str,
137	    weight_bf16: torch.Tensor,
138	    num_logical_weights: int | None = None,
139	) -> None:
140	    """Pack weight and add the three NVFP4 tensors to the output dict."""
141	    packed, scale, scale2 = pack_nvfp4(weight_bf16)

143	    tensors[f"{sglang_key}.weight_scale"] = scale
144	    if num_logical_weights is not None:

215	        # with a leading dot so it also bypasses stacked_params_mapping.
216	        gate_up_merged = torch.cat([

218	            get("midlayer.mlp.up_proj.weight"),

220	        add_nvfp4_tensors(
221	            tensors,
222	            "model.midlayer.mlp.gate_up_proj",
223	            gate_up_merged,
224	            num_logical_weights=2,
225	        )
226	        del gate_up_merged

228	        add_nvfp4_tensors(tensors, "model.midlayer.mlp.down_proj",
229	                          get("midlayer.mlp.down_proj.weight"))

231	        # lm_head: keep bf16 (not NVFP4). sglang loads it via

234	        if LM_HEAD_BF16:
235	            tensors["lm_head.weight"] = get("lm_head.weight")
236	        else:

238	
239	    else:
240	        # ── BF16 layers (legacy path) ──────────────────────────────────
241	        key_mapping = {
242	            "fc.weight":                              "model.fc.weight",
243	            "midlayer.self_attn.q_proj.weight":       "model.midlayer.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
244	            "midlayer.self_attn.k_proj.weight":       "model.midlayer.self_attn.k_proj.weight",

250	            "norm.weight":                            "model.norm.weight",
251	            "lm_head.weight":                         "lm_head.weight",
252	        }
253	        for train_key, sglang_key in key_mapping.items():
254	            if train_key in state:
255	                tensors[sglang_key] = state[train_key].to(torch.bfloat16)
256	            else:
257	                print(f"  WARNING: missing key {train_key}")

259	    # ── Norm weights (always BF16) ─────────────────────────────────────
260	    tensors["model.midlayer.input_layernorm.weight"]        = get("midlayer.input_emb_norm.weight")
261	    tensors["model.midlayer.hidden_norm.weight"]            = get("midlayer.hidden_norm.weight")
262	    tensors["model.midlayer.post_attention_layernorm.weight"] = get("midlayer.post_attention_layernorm.weight")
263	    tensors["model.norm.weight"]                            = get("norm.weight")

276	    print(f"Saved {len(tensors)} tensors to {OUTPUT_DIR / 'model.safetensors'}")

339	                  "tokenizer.model", "added_tokens.json"]:
340	        src = os.path.join(TARGET_MODEL, fname)

344	            print(f"Copied {fname}")

347	    print(f"\nOutput directory: {OUTPUT_DIR}")
348	    for fp in sorted(OUTPUT_DIR.iterdir()):
349	        sz = fp.stat().st_size

44	def _load_v4_d2t_diff(vocab_cache_path: Path) -> torch.Tensor:
45	    cache = torch.load(vocab_cache_path, weights_only=True, map_location="cpu")
46	    if "selected_ids" in cache:
47	        selected_ids = cache["selected_ids"].long()
48	        if selected_ids.numel() != DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE:
49	            raise ValueError(
50	                f"selected_ids has {selected_ids.numel()} entries, expected {DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE}"
51	            )
52	        return selected_ids - torch.arange(DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.long)
53	
54	    d2t = cache["d2t"].long()
55	    if d2t.numel() != DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE:
56	        raise ValueError(f"d2t has {d2t.numel()} entries, expected {DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE}")
57	    # v4 cache stores diff-format d2t. Keep this branch for robustness if the
58	    # cache is regenerated without selected_ids.
59	    if int(d2t.max()) < VOCAB_SIZE and int(d2t.min()) >= -DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE:
60	        return d2t
61	    return d2t - torch.arange(DRAFT_VOCAB_SIZE, dtype=torch.long)

26	def build_model():

28	    model = v4train.Eagle3ModelV4(embed_w, lm_head_w).to(v4train.DEVICE).to(v4train.DTYPE)

37	def smoke(model, get_batch, label: str, steps: int = 30, lr: float = 5e-5):
38	    opt = torch.optim.AdamW([p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad], lr=lr)
39	    losses = []
40	    accs = []
41	    model.train()
42	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
43	    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
44	    t0 = time.time()
45	    n_tokens = 0
46	    for step in range(steps):
47	        batch = get_batch()
48	        opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
49	        loss, _, step_accs = model(**batch)
50	        loss.backward()
51	        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
52	        opt.step()
53	        losses.append(float(loss.item()))
54	        accs.append(step_accs[0])
55	        n_tokens += int(batch["token_ids"].numel())
56	        if step % 5 == 0 or step == steps - 1:
57	            print(f"  {label} step {step:3d}: loss={loss.item():.4f}  acc0={step_accs[0]:.4f}")
58	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
59	    dt = time.time() - t0
60	    peak_mb = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / 1e6
61	    avg_loss_first5 = sum(losses[:5]) / 5
62	    avg_loss_last5 = sum(losses[-5:]) / 5
63	    avg_acc0_last5 = sum(accs[-5:]) / 5
64	    print(f"  {label} {steps} steps in {dt:.1f}s  ({n_tokens/dt:.0f} tok/s, "
65	          f"peak={peak_mb:.0f} MB)")
66	    print(f"  {label} loss first5={avg_loss_first5:.4f} → last5={avg_loss_last5:.4f}, "
67	          f"acc0 last5={avg_acc0_last5:.4f}")
68	    return dt, n_tokens, avg_loss_last5, avg_acc0_last5
69	
70	
71	def main():
72	    data_dir = Path("eagle/data/target_regen/v2mix_10k")
73	    files = sorted(data_dir.glob("*.pt"))
74	    random.seed(0)
75	    random.shuffle(files)
76	    files = files[:200]   # subset for smoke
77	
78	    print(f"PyTorch {torch.__version__} on {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
79	    model = build_model()
80	
81	    SEQ_LEN = 4096
82	    BATCH = 4
83	
84	    file_pos = [0]
85	
86	    def next_files(n: int):
87	        out = []
88	        while len(out) < n:
89	            if file_pos[0] >= len(files):
90	                random.shuffle(files)
91	                file_pos[0] = 0
92	            out.append(files[file_pos[0]])
93	            file_pos[0] += 1
94	        return out
95	
96	    # ---- Non-packed ----
97	    def get_np_batch():
98	        bf = next_files(BATCH)
99	        samples = [torch.load(f, weights_only=True, map_location="cpu") for f in bf]
100	        return v4train.make_batch_v4(samples, SEQ_LEN, tail=False)
101	
102	    print("\n=== Non-packed (BS=4, BS_files per step=4) ===")
103	    smoke(model, get_np_batch, "PACK=0", steps=20)
104	
105	    # Reset model state for fair comparison.
106	    print("\n--- rebuilding model for PACK=1 run ---")
107	    del model
108	    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
109	    model = build_model()
110	
111	    # ---- Packed ----
112	    len_cache = data_dir.parent / f"{data_dir.name}.lengths.json"
113	    lengths = index_lengths(data_dir, len_cache, verbose=False)
114	    sampler = PackedFileSampler(files=files, lengths=lengths,
115	                                max_len=SEQ_LEN, min_seg_len=64,
116	                                ttt_pad=3, rng=random.Random(0))
117	
118	    def get_p_batch():
119	        bf = sampler.next_bin()
120	        samples = [torch.load(f, weights_only=True, map_location="cpu") for f in bf]
121	        return make_packed_batch(samples, max_len=SEQ_LEN, ttt_steps=3,
122	                                 device=v4train.DEVICE, dtype=v4train.DTYPE,
123	                                 min_seg_len=64)
124	
125	    print("\n=== Packed (BS=1 per step, multiple segs/bin) ===")
126	    smoke(model, get_p_batch, "PACK=1", steps=20)

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Core correctness tests for SALA draft sequence packing.
3	
4	Pruned to only what we actually rely on:
5	  - mask_segment_tail: tail-mask must catch every position polluted by TTT shift
6	  - aoi_position_ids_packed: per-segment positional layout sanity
7	  - pack_samples / make_packed_batch: doc_ids & padding layout
8	  - SDPA matrix mask numerically isolates segments (the building block)
9	  - V4 forward, multi-segment: perturbing seg1 does NOT change seg0's
10	    mask=True logits at any TTT step (the property that backs loss safety)
11	  - V4 forward: padded packed loss == unpadded packed loss (no pad pollution)
12	  - V4 forward: packed loss decomposes as a length-weighted sum of
13	    per-segment losses (proves packing does not redistribute loss)
14	
15	Run from repo user_4813494d:
16	    python3 eagle/training/sala_draft/test_packing.py
17	"""

68	class _DeterministicRandint:
69	    """Force random.randint → 0 inside; gives deterministic AOI."""
70	    def __enter__(self):
71	        import random as _r
72	        self._orig = _r.randint
73	        _r.randint = lambda lo, hi: 0
74	        return self
75	
76	    def __exit__(self, *exc):
77	        import random as _r
78	        _r.randint = self._orig

81	def _step_valid_mask(am_shifted: torch.Tensor, step: int) -> torch.Tensor:
82	    """Return assistant_mask shifted left by `step` positions, 0-padded."""
83	    out = am_shifted.clone()
84	    for _ in range(step):
85	        zero = torch.zeros(out.shape[0], 1, dtype=out.dtype, device=out.device)
86	        out = torch.cat([out[:, 1:], zero], dim=1)
87	    return out

142	    """Sample with the keys make_packed_batch expects, sized to real arch."""
143	    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)

159	def _capture_logits(model, batch):
160	    """Run model forward and capture per-step lm_head outputs."""
161	    captured = []
162	    orig_lm = model.lm_head
163	
164	    class _Tee(torch.nn.Module):
165	        def __init__(self, inner):
166	            super().__init__()
167	            self.inner = inner
168	
169	        def forward(self, x):
170	            out = self.inner(x)
171	            captured.append(out.detach().clone())
172	            return out
173	
174	        @property
175	        def weight(self):
176	            return self.inner.weight
177	
178	    model.lm_head = _Tee(orig_lm)
179	    try:
180	        with torch.no_grad():
181	            total_loss, step_losses, step_accs = model(**batch)
182	    finally:
183	        model.lm_head = orig_lm
184	    return total_loss, step_losses, step_accs, captured

263	def test_sdpa_cross_doc_isolation():
264	    section("SDPA cross-doc isolation")
265	    torch.manual_seed(0)
266	    B, H, S, D = 1, 4, 8, 16
267	    q = torch.randn(B, H, S, D)
268	    k = torch.randn(B, H, S, D)
269	    v = torch.randn(B, H, S, D)
270	
271	    doc = torch.tensor([[0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1]])
272	    causal = torch.tril(torch.ones(S, S))
273	    doc_eq = (doc.unsqueeze(2) == doc.unsqueeze(1)).float()
274	    additive = torch.where((causal.unsqueeze(0) * doc_eq) > 0,
275	                           0.0, float("-inf")).unsqueeze(1)
276	
277	    out_packed = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=additive)
278	
279	    k2, v2 = k.clone(), v.clone()
280	    k2[:, :, :4, :] += 100.0
281	    v2[:, :, :4, :] += 100.0
282	    out_perturbed = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k2, v2, attn_mask=additive)
283	
284	    diff_seg2 = (out_packed[:, :, 4:] - out_perturbed[:, :, 4:]).abs().max().item()
285	    check("seg2 output stable when seg1 perturbed",
286	          diff_seg2 < 1e-6, f"diff={diff_seg2:.3e}")

303	    s2_perturbed = dict(s2)
304	    s2_perturbed["aux_hidden"] = s2["aux_hidden"] * 100.0
305	    s2_perturbed["token_ids"] = (s2["token_ids"] + 7) % DRAFT
306

308	                           device=_TEST_DEVICE, dtype=_TEST_DTYPE)
309	    bp_p = make_packed_batch([s1, s2_perturbed], max_len=L1 + L2, ttt_steps=3,

311

314	        _, _, _, logits_a = _capture_logits(model, bp)
315	    with _DeterministicRandint():

317	
318	    am_shifted = bp["assistant_mask"][:, 1:]
319	    seg0_am = am_shifted[:, :L1 - 1]
320	    for step in range(3):
321	        valid = _step_valid_mask(seg0_am, step)
322	        if not valid.any():
323	            check(f"seg0 step{step} valid count > 0", False)
324	            continue
325	        sa = logits_a[step][:, :L1 - 1, :]
326	        sb = logits_b[step][:, :L1 - 1, :]
327	        d = (sa - sb).float().abs()[valid].max().item()
328	        check(f"seg0 step{step} mask=True unchanged (max|Δ|={d:.2e})",
329	              d < 1e-3, f"max|Δ|={d:.3e}")

331	    # Sanity: seg1 must change (perturbation took effect).
332	    seg1_a = logits_a[0][:, L1 - 1:, :]

334	    diff_seg1 = (seg1_a - seg1_b).float().abs().max().item()

36	def build_model_and_opt():

40	    v3train.init_mlp_from_target(model)
41	    model.train()
42	    decay, no_decay = [], []
43	    for name, p in model.named_parameters():
44	        if not p.requires_grad: continue
45	        (no_decay if (name.endswith(".bias") or name.endswith("norm.weight")) else decay).append(p)
46	    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(
47	        [{"params": decay, "weight_decay": 0.01},
48	         {"params": no_decay, "weight_decay": 0.0}],
49	        lr=5e-4, betas=(0.9, 0.95), fused=True,
50	    )
51	    return model, opt

54	def make_build(sampler, BS, S, T):
55	    def build_one():
56	        bin_dicts = []

60	            bin_dicts.append(make_packed_batch(

62	                dtype=v4train.DTYPE, min_seg_len=64, pin_memory=False,
63	            ))
64	        out = {}
65	        for k in bin_dicts[0]:
66	            v0 = bin_dicts[0][k]
67	            if torch.is_tensor(v0):
68	                t = torch.cat([d[k] for d in bin_dicts], dim=0)
69	                if torch.cuda.is_available():
70	                    t = t.pin_memory()
71	                out[k] = t
72	            else:
73	                out[k] = v0
74	        return out
75	    return build_one

81	        for k, v in batch.items()
82	    }

109	                loss, _, _ = model(**batch)
110	                (loss / GA).backward()
111	            opt.step()

113

124	                    if batch is None: continue
125	                    batch = to_cuda(batch)
126	                    loss, _, _ = model(**batch)

132

1	"""FP4 quantization for EAGLE-3 draft training.
2	
3	Two forward modes share one ``FP4QATLinear`` interface:
4	
5	  * **NVFP4_FORWARD=1** (default when sgl-kernel + flashinfer present, sm_120):
6	    Real 4-bit GEMM via ``flashinfer.mm_fp4(use_nvfp4=True, backend="cutlass")``.
7	    Backward is bf16 STE — gradients flow through the master bf16 weight as if
8	    fake-quant, so optimizer behaviour is unchanged.
9	
10	  * **NVFP4_FORWARD=0**: Legacy fake-STE — bf16 GEMM with FP4-rounded weight
11	    (``_FP4QuantSTE``). Identical math, ~5x slower.
12	
13	Public API:
14	    FP4QATLinear           drop-in replacement for nn.Linear
15	    fp4_quant_freeze(model)   pre-quantize weights once per training step so
16	                              multi-step (TTT) forwards reuse the cached FP4
17	                              representation
18	    fp4_quant_unfreeze(model) clear cache (called at end of forward)
19	
20	Toggles (env):
21	    EAGLE_NVFP4_FORWARD=0/1   (default 1)  switch between true 4-bit and fake STE
22	    EAGLE_NVFP4_EXCLUDE_LM_HEAD=0/1 (default 1)  skip lm_head; vocab-projection
23	                              quant-noise leaks into every token's softmax
24	    SGLANG_FP4_TUNE_CACHE     path to flashinfer autotune JSON (loaded lazily)
25	
26	Convention (per ``sgl-kernel/tests/test_fp4_gemm.py``):
27	    gs = (E4M3_max * FP4_max) / amax = 2688 / amax    (multiplied onto input)
28	    alpha = 1 / (gs_a * gs_b)                          (descales output)

92	    _NVFP4_AUTOTUNE_LOADED = True
93	
94	
95	# ── STE round (legacy fake-quant path) ────────────────────────────────────
96	
97	def _fp4_round(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
98	    """Round each element to the nearest FP4 E2M1 representable value.
99	
100	    Input: any float tensor (preferably already in [-6, 6]).
101	    Output: same dtype, values in {0, ±0.5, ±1, ±1.5, ±2, ±3, ±4, ±6}.
102	    """
103	    pos = _FP4_POS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
104	    bounds = _FP4_BOUNDS.to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
105	    sign = x.sign()
106	    idx = torch.bucketize(x.abs().clamp(max=6.0), bounds)
107	    return sign * pos[idx]
108	
109	
110	class _FP4QuantSTE(torch.autograd.Function):
111	    """Fake-quantize weight to FP4 E2M1 in forward; straight-through in backward.
112	
113	    Per-group-of-16 scaling: ``scale = max(|w_group|) / 6.0``. Stays in the
114	    weight's native dtype (bf16); only the per-group scale (1 value per 16
115	    weights) goes through fp32 for clamp stability.
116	    """
117	    @staticmethod
118	    def forward(ctx, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
119	        N, K = weight.shape
120	        w_g = weight.reshape(N, K // FP4_GROUP_SIZE, FP4_GROUP_SIZE)
121	        abs_max = w_g.abs().amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
122	        scale = (abs_max.float().clamp(min=1e-8) / 6.0).to(weight.dtype)
123	        w_q = _fp4_round(w_g / scale) * scale
124	        return w_q.reshape(N, K)
125	
126	    @staticmethod
127	    def backward(ctx, grad: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
128	        return grad  # STE
129	
130	
131	# ── True 4-bit forward path (NVFP4 cutlass) ───────────────────────────────
132	
133	def _compute_global_scale(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
134	    """Per-tensor input_global_scale matching the NVFP4 reference."""
135	    amax = t.detach().abs().amax().to(torch.float32).clamp(min=1e-6)
136	    return (_FP4_E4M3_E2M1_PRODUCT / amax).view(1)
137	
138	
139	class _NVFP4LinearFn(torch.autograd.Function):
140	    """Forward: NVFP4 GEMM (true 4-bit). Backward: bf16 STE.
141	
142	    NVFP4 official scale convention applied so input_global_scale * input fits
143	    the joint FP4*E4M3 dynamic range. ``alpha = 1 / (gs_x * gs_w)`` descales
144	    the output back to the original magnitude. Without this, weights with
145	    small amax (e.g. ~0.01 after init_mlp_from_target) trigger e4m3 underflow
146	    and the GEMM produces NaN on entire blocks.
147	
148	    STE backward: forward uses the FP4-quantized weight, but the gradient
149	    w.r.t. the master bf16 weight is the standard linear gradient
150	    (grad_w = grad_out.T @ x), identical to the legacy fake-quant STE.
151	    """
152	    @staticmethod
153	    def forward(ctx, x, weight_bf16, wq, wsf, w_gs):
154	        _maybe_load_nvfp4_autotune()
155	        x2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]).contiguous()
156	        x_gs = _compute_global_scale(x2d)
157	        xq, xsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(x2d, x_gs)
158	        alpha = (1.0 / (x_gs * w_gs)).contiguous()
159	        out2d = _fi_mm_fp4(
160	            xq, wq.T, xsf, wsf.T, alpha,
161	            out_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
162	            block_size=16, use_nvfp4=True, backend="cutlass",
163	        )
164	        out_shape = list(x.shape[:-1]) + [out2d.shape[-1]]
165	        ctx.save_for_backward(x, weight_bf16)
166	        return out2d.view(out_shape)
167	
168	    @staticmethod
169	    def backward(ctx, grad_out):
170	        x, w = ctx.saved_tensors
171	        grad_out_2d = grad_out.reshape(-1, grad_out.shape[-1])
172	        x_2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1])
173	        grad_x = (grad_out_2d @ w).view_as(x)
174	        grad_w = grad_out_2d.t() @ x_2d
175	        return grad_x, grad_w, None, None, None
176	
177	
178	# ── Linear wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
179	
180	class FP4QATLinear(nn.Linear):
181	    """nn.Linear with FP4 fake-quantization on weights during training.
182	
183	    Eval / FP4_QAT=False / ``_fp4_skip=True``: plain bf16 ``F.linear`` so the
184	    final RTN export matches inference exactly.
185	    """
186	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
187	        if not (self.training and FP4_QAT):
188	            return F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
189	        if getattr(self, "_fp4_skip", False):
190	            return F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
191	
192	        if NVFP4_FORWARD:
193	            wq = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw_packed", None)
194	            wsf = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw_sf", None)
195	            w_gs = getattr(self, "_fp4_w_gs", None)
196	            if wq is None:
197	                w_gs = _compute_global_scale(self.weight)
198	                wq, wsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(self.weight, w_gs)
199	            out = _NVFP4LinearFn.apply(x, self.weight, wq, wsf, w_gs)
200	            return out if self.bias is None else (out + self.bias)
201	
202	        # Legacy fake-STE (bf16 GEMM, FP4-rounded weight).
203	        qw = getattr(self, "_fp4_qw", None)
204	        if qw is None:
205	            qw = _FP4QuantSTE.apply(self.weight)
206	        return F.linear(x, qw, self.bias)
207	
208	
209	def fp4_quant_freeze(model: nn.Module) -> None:
210	    """Pre-quantize every FP4QATLinear weight so multi-step forwards reuse it.
211	
212	    NVFP4_FORWARD=1: caches packed (wq, wsf, w_gs) — weight quantize cost is
213	    paid once per optimizer step instead of TTT_STEPS times.
214	    NVFP4_FORWARD=0: caches fake-STE quantized weight (bf16 tensor).
215	    """
216	    if not FP4_QAT:
217	        return
218	    for m in model.modules():
219	        if isinstance(m, FP4QATLinear) and m.training:
220	            if getattr(m, "_fp4_skip", False):
221	                continue
222	            if NVFP4_FORWARD:
223	                with torch.no_grad():
224	                    w_gs = _compute_global_scale(m.weight)
225	                    wq, wsf = _sgl_scaled_fp4_quant(m.weight, w_gs)
226	                m._fp4_qw_packed = wq
227	                m._fp4_qw_sf = wsf
228	                m._fp4_w_gs = w_gs
229	            else:
230	                m._fp4_qw = _FP4QuantSTE.apply(m.weight)
231	
232	
233	def fp4_quant_unfreeze(model: nn.Module) -> None:
234	    """Clear the per-step quantized-weight cache after backward."""
235	    for m in model.modules():
236	        if isinstance(m, FP4QATLinear):
237	            m._fp4_qw = None
238	            m._fp4_qw_packed = None
239	            m._fp4_qw_sf = None
240	            m._fp4_w_gs = None
241

1	"""Sequence packing for SALA EAGLE-3 draft training.
2	
3	Pack multiple variable-length samples into one fixed-budget sequence to
4	eliminate padding waste. Each segment is fully isolated:
5	
6	  * Per-segment ``document_ids`` (0, 1, 2, ...). Cross-doc attention mask in
7	    the trainer blocks attention across segment boundaries.
8	  * Per-segment AOI sink + offset, so each segment's RoPE positions look
9	    independent (no global anchor on a packed sequence).
10	  * Per-segment tail masking. The trainer's TTT step k>0 left-shifts inputs
11	    by ``k`` positions, which on packed sequences pulls tokens from the
12	    next segment into the current segment's tail. We zero out the
13	    ``assistant_mask`` for the last ``ttt_steps`` positions of each segment
14	    so those polluted positions do not contribute to the loss.
15	
16	Public surface:
17	    index_lengths(data_dir, cache_path, force=False)
18	    pack_samples(samples, max_len, min_seg_len=64)
19	    aoi_position_ids_packed(seq_len, batch_size, document_ids, device,
20	                            training, aoi_cap, aoi_max_sink)
21	    mask_segment_tail(assistant_mask, document_ids, n_pad)
22	    make_packed_batch(samples, max_len, ttt_steps, device, dtype, min_seg_len=64)
23	    PackedFileSampler(files, lengths, max_len, min_seg_len)
24	"""
25	from __future__ import annotations
26	
27	import json
28	import multiprocessing as mp
29	import os
30	import random
31	import time
32	from pathlib import Path
33	
34	import torch
35	
36	
37	# ── Length index ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
38	
39	def _index_one(path_str: str) -> tuple[str, int | None, str | None]:
40	    """Single-file worker: returns (name, n_tokens, error_or_None).
41	
42	    Defined at module top level so multiprocessing.Pool can pickle it.
43	    """
44	    p = Path(path_str)
45	    try:
46	        d = torch.load(p, weights_only=True, map_location="cpu")
47	        return p.name, int(d["token_ids"].shape[0]), None
48	    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
49	        return p.name, None, f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
50	
51	
52	def index_lengths(data_dir: Path, cache_path: Path,
53	                  force: bool = False, verbose: bool = True,
54	                  num_workers: int | None = None) -> dict[str, int]:
55	    """Build {filename: token_ids length} index, persisted as JSON.
56	
57	    Loads every .pt once and records its ``token_ids`` length. Uses a
58	    multiprocessing pool to parallelize the torch.load — single-process
59	    runs at ~50 file/s due to I/O, multi-process scales linearly until
60	    storage saturates. Subsequent calls short-circuit on the cache; new
61	    files get filled in incrementally.
62	
63	    num_workers default = min(32, os.cpu_count() // 2). The bottleneck is
64	    storage IOPS, not CPU; oversubscribing has no benefit.
65	    """
66	    cache_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
67	    cached: dict[str, int] = {}
68	    if cache_path.exists() and not force:
69	        try:
70	            cached = json.loads(cache_path.read_text())
71	        except Exception:
72	            cached = {}
73	
74	    files = sorted(data_dir.glob("*.pt"))
75	    missing = [f for f in files if f.name not in cached]
76	    if not missing:
77	        return cached
78	
79	    if num_workers is None:
80	        num_workers = min(32, max(2, (os.cpu_count() or 4) // 2))
81	
82	    if verbose:
83	        print(f"[packing.index_lengths] {data_dir}: {len(missing)} new files to scan "
84	              f"({len(cached)} cached, {len(files)} total, workers={num_workers})")
85	    t0 = time.time()
86	    n_done = 0
87	    n_skip = 0
88	
89	    # fork is fine here: workers only do torch.load(map_location="cpu") and
90	    # never touch CUDA, so fork-time CUDA state inheritance is harmless. spawn
91	    # would re-import the parent's __main__ (which tries to rebuild the full
92	    # model + optimizer in every worker on every TTT step — many minutes lost
93	    # before the first index even completes).
94	    ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
95	    chunksize = max(1, len(missing) // (num_workers * 16) or 1)
96	    paths = [str(f) for f in missing]
97	
98	    with ctx.Pool(processes=num_workers) as pool:
99	        for name, n, err in pool.imap_unordered(_index_one, paths, chunksize=chunksize):
100	            n_done += 1
101	            if n is None:
102	                n_skip += 1
103	                if verbose:
104	                    print(f"  skip {name}: {err}")
105	                continue
106	            cached[name] = n
107	            if verbose and n_done % 1000 == 0:
108	                rate = n_done / (time.time() - t0)
109	                print(f"  scanned {n_done}/{len(missing)} ({time.time()-t0:.1f}s, {rate:.0f}/s)")
110	
111	    cache_path.write_text(json.dumps(cached))
112	    if verbose:
113	        print(f"[packing.index_lengths] wrote {cache_path} ({len(cached)} entries, "
114	              f"{n_skip} skipped, {time.time()-t0:.1f}s)")
115	    return cached
116	
117	
118	# ── Pack one bin from a list of loaded samples ─────────────────────────
119	
120	PACK_KEYS = (
121	    "token_ids",
122	    "aux_hidden",
123	    "top_logit_values",
124	    "top_logit_indices",
125	    "target_logsumexp",
126	    "assistant_mask",
127	)
128	
129	
130	def pack_samples(samples: list[dict], max_len: int,
131	                 min_seg_len: int = 64) -> dict | None:
132	    """Concatenate already-loaded samples along the seq axis.
133	
134	    Returns one packed dict (single-row, no batch dim) or None if no
135	    segment is admissible. Segments shorter than ``min_seg_len`` are
136	    silently dropped (they cannot afford the TTT tail masking).
137	
138	    Stops adding segments once the running length would exceed ``max_len``.
139	    The caller (bin packer) is responsible for choosing which samples to
140	    feed in; this routine does not reorder.
141	    """
142	    pieces = []
143	    total = 0
144	    for s in samples:
145	        n = int(s["token_ids"].shape[0])
146	        if n < min_seg_len:
147	            continue
148	        if total + n > max_len:
149	            continue
150	        pieces.append((s, n))
151	        total += n
152	    if not pieces:
153	        return None
154	
155	    out: dict = {}
156	    for k in PACK_KEYS:
157	        out[k] = torch.cat([s[k] for s, _ in pieces], dim=0)
158	
159	    seg_pieces = []
160	    for seg_idx, (_, n) in enumerate(pieces):
161	        seg_pieces.append(torch.full((n,), seg_idx, dtype=torch.int32))
162	    out["document_ids"] = torch.cat(seg_pieces, dim=0)
163	    out["_segment_lengths"] = [n for _, n in pieces]
164	    return out
165	
166	
167	# ── AOI per-segment positions ──────────────────────────────────────────
168	
169	def aoi_position_ids_packed(seq_len: int, batch_size: int,
170	                            document_ids: torch.Tensor,
171	                            device, training: bool,
172	                            aoi_cap: int, aoi_max_sink: int) -> torch.Tensor:
173	    """LongSpec AOI extended to packed sequences.
174	
175	    Each segment (run of equal ``document_ids[b]``) is treated as if it were
176	    a standalone shard:
177	        sink ~ U[0, aoi_max_sink]
178	        offset ~ U[0, aoi_cap - seg_len]
179	        pos = arange(seg_len), pos[sink:] += offset
180	    In eval / non-training mode positions are simply 0..S-1 globally.
181	    """
182	    if not training or seq_len >= aoi_cap:
183	        return (torch.arange(seq_len, device=device)
184	                .unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1).contiguous())
185	
186	    out = torch.zeros(batch_size, seq_len, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
187	    for b in range(batch_size):
188	        doc_row = document_ids[b]
189	        # Boundaries: indices where the segment starts.
190	        change = (doc_row[1:] != doc_row[:-1]).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
191	        starts = [0] + (change + 1).tolist() + [seq_len]
192	        for i in range(len(starts) - 1):
193	            seg_start = starts[i]
194	            seg_end = starts[i + 1]
195	            seg_len = seg_end - seg_start
196	            if seg_len <= 0:
197	                continue
198	            sink = random.randint(0, aoi_max_sink)
199	            offset_max = max(0, aoi_cap - seg_len)
200	            offset = random.randint(0, offset_max) if offset_max > 0 else 0
201	            pos = torch.arange(seg_len, device=device)
202	            if sink < seg_len:
203	                pos[sink:] = pos[sink:] + offset
204	            out[b, seg_start:seg_end] = pos
205	    return out
206	
207	
208	# ── TTT tail mask ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
209	
210	def mask_segment_tail(assistant_mask: torch.Tensor,
211	                      document_ids: torch.Tensor,
212	                      n_pad: int) -> torch.Tensor:
213	    """Zero out the last ``n_pad`` positions of each segment.
214	
215	    A position p is "safe" iff for every k in [1, n_pad]:
216	        p + k is in-bounds AND document_ids[p + k] == document_ids[p].
217	    Otherwise after TTT left-shift by k the input at position p originates
218	    from a different segment (or out of bounds), so its supervision is
219	    polluted and we must drop it from the loss.
220	    """
221	    if n_pad <= 0:
222	        return assistant_mask
223	    am = assistant_mask.bool().clone() if assistant_mask.dtype != torch.bool \
224	        else assistant_mask.clone()
225	    B, S = document_ids.shape
226	    for k in range(1, n_pad + 1):
227	        valid = S - k
228	        if valid > 0:
229	            same = document_ids[:, :valid] == document_ids[:, k:k + valid]
230	            am[:, :valid] = am[:, :valid] & same
231	        # Positions in [S-k, S) cannot satisfy the "p+k in range" condition.
232	        if valid < S:
233	            am[:, max(valid, 0):S] = False
234	    return am
235	
236	
237	# ── Bin-packing dataset wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────
238	
239	class PackedFileSampler:
240	    """First-fit-decreasing bin packer over a static file list.
241	
242	    Each call to ``next_bin()`` returns a list of file paths whose
243	    ``token_ids`` lengths fit a single packed sequence of ``max_len``.
244	    Files shorter than ``min_seg_len`` are dropped at index time.
245	
246	    Internally the sampler keeps a shuffled list of (path, length) pairs
247	    and consumes them in FFD greedy order. When the pool empties it
248	    reshuffles. This is randomized but reproducible across epochs.
249	    """
250	
251	    def __init__(self, files: list[Path], lengths: dict[str, int],
252	                 max_len: int, min_seg_len: int = 64,
253	                 ttt_pad: int = 0, rng: random.Random | None = None):
254	        self.max_len = max_len
255	        self.min_seg_len = min_seg_len
256	        self.ttt_pad = ttt_pad
257	        self.rng = rng or random
258	        self._all = [
259	            (p, int(lengths[p.name]))
260	            for p in files
261	            if p.name in lengths and int(lengths[p.name]) >= min_seg_len
262	        ]
263	        if not self._all:
264	            raise RuntimeError("PackedFileSampler: no files >= min_seg_len after indexing")
265	        self._reset_pool()
266	
267	    def _reset_pool(self):
268	        pool = list(self._all)
269	        self.rng.shuffle(pool)
270	        # Sort by length descending — FFD prefers placing the largest first.
271	        pool.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
272	        self._pool = pool
273	
274	    def stats(self) -> dict:
275	        lens = [n for _, n in self._all]
276	        return {
277	            "n_files": len(self._all),
278	            "min_len": min(lens),
279	            "max_len": max(lens),
280	            "mean_len": sum(lens) / len(lens),
281	            "pool_remaining": len(self._pool),
282	        }
283	
284	    def next_bin(self) -> list[Path]:
285	        """Return file paths for one packed batch. Reshuffles when the pool
286	        empties without ever returning an empty bin (raises only if no
287	        single file fits — which would mean min_seg_len > max_len).
288	        """
289	        bin_files: list[Path] = []
290	        bin_filled = 0
291	        # Walk the pool once looking for files that fit.
292	        kept_indices: list[int] = []
293	        for i, (p, n) in enumerate(self._pool):
294	            if bin_filled + n <= self.max_len:
295	                bin_files.append(p)
296	                bin_filled += n
297	            else:
298	                kept_indices.append(i)
299	        # Compute the survivors (everything we didn't consume).
300	        new_pool = [self._pool[i] for i in kept_indices]
301	        # If the pool actually became smaller, this round made progress.
302	        if len(new_pool) < len(self._pool):
303	            self._pool = new_pool
304	        else:
305	            # Nothing fit (e.g. all remaining files exceed max_len).
306	            # Drop the first (largest leftover) so we don't loop.
307	            self._pool = self._pool[1:]
308	        if not self._pool:
309	            self._reset_pool()
310	        if not bin_files:
311	            # Single file exceeds max_len: take the smallest one anyway.
312	            small = min(self._all, key=lambda x: x[1])
313	            bin_files = [small[0]]
314	        return bin_files
315	
316	
317	# ── Top-level batch builder ────────────────────────────────────────────
318	
319	def make_packed_batch(samples: list[dict], max_len: int, ttt_steps: int,
320	                      device: str | torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype,
321	                      min_seg_len: int = 64,
322	                      pin_memory: bool = False) -> dict:
323	    """Build a (B=1) packed batch.
324	
325	    Tail masking is applied to ``assistant_mask`` on whichever device we
326	    end on. ``pin_memory=True`` is honored only when device==cpu (CUDA
327	    tensors are already in device memory).
328	
329	    Stream-separation pattern: caller passes ``device='cpu', pin_memory=True``
330	    inside a worker thread, then in the main thread does
331	    ``{k: v.to('cuda', non_blocking=True) for k, v in batch.items()}`` so
332	    H2D copy runs on PyTorch's default copy stream and overlaps with
333	    forward compute on the main stream.
334	    """
335	    packed = pack_samples(samples, max_len, min_seg_len=min_seg_len)
336	    if packed is None:
337	        raise RuntimeError("make_packed_batch: pack_samples returned None")
338	
339	    n_real = packed["token_ids"].shape[0]
340	    if n_real < max_len:
341	        pad_len = max_len - n_real
342	        for k, t in list(packed.items()):
343	            if k.startswith("_") or not torch.is_tensor(t):
344	                continue
345	            pad_shape = list(t.shape)
346	            pad_shape[0] = pad_len
347	            pad_value = 0
348	            pad = torch.full(pad_shape, pad_value, dtype=t.dtype)
349	            packed[k] = torch.cat([t, pad], dim=0)
350	        pad_doc = int(packed["document_ids"][n_real - 1].item()) + 1
351	        packed["document_ids"][n_real:] = pad_doc
352	        packed["assistant_mask"][n_real:] = False
353	
354	    # Build batch on CPU first (cheap dtype casts only), then move/pin.
355	    out = {
356	        "token_ids": packed["token_ids"].unsqueeze(0).long(),
357	        "aux_hidden": packed["aux_hidden"].unsqueeze(0).to(dtype),
358	        "target_logits_values": packed["top_logit_values"].unsqueeze(0).to(torch.float32),

361	        "assistant_mask": packed["assistant_mask"].unsqueeze(0).bool(),
362	        "document_ids": packed["document_ids"].unsqueeze(0).long(),
363	        "is_packed": True,
364	    }
365	    # Apply TTT tail masking on CPU before the H2D copy so the GPU never
366	    # sees an unmasked tail (and so we can keep the .to() unconditional).
367	    out["assistant_mask"] = mask_segment_tail(
368	        out["assistant_mask"], out["document_ids"], n_pad=ttt_steps
369	    )
370	
371	    is_cpu_target = (str(device) == "cpu")
372	    if pin_memory and is_cpu_target and torch.cuda.is_available():
373	        for k, v in list(out.items()):
374	            if torch.is_tensor(v):
375	                out[k] = v.pin_memory()
376	    elif not is_cpu_target:
377	        for k, v in list(out.items()):
378	            if torch.is_tensor(v):
379	                out[k] = v.to(device, non_blocking=True)
